title: Budget
description: Represents a monthly budget model consisting of pay periods and their associated entries.

payPeriods.description: List of pay periods within the budget month.

PayPeriodBudget.description: Budget details for a specific pay period in the month.

seqNbr.description: Sequence number of the pay period within the month (e.g., 1 for first pay period).

budgetEntries.description: List of budget entries (income or expenses) for this pay period.

BudgetEntry.description: Represents a single budget entry, such as income or expense.

direction.description: Indicates whether the entry is income ('I') or expense ('E').

type.description: Categorization of the entry, e.g., paycheck, bill, or savings transfer.

expectedAmount.description: Expected monetary amount for this entry.

description.description: Free-form text description of the entry (e.g., 'Electric bill for December').

matchKey.description: Text field used to match this entry against a transaction in the bank statement (e.g., 'ACH-12345').
